raw: The previous adjustments to P1’s Y-axis position have not yet aligned it correctly. The door_1_right (P1) still shows positional deviation during both open and shut states. Since translating along Y has not resolved the issue, I will now try a small rotation of P1 around its own Z-axis to realign its orientation and check if that improves the fit. This may help correct the door’s swing path without altering its size or hinge position. I will simulate a small Z-axis rotation of P1.
